beats: Number of narration beats or scenes the video divides into
captions: Number of burned-in phrases that follow speech or lyrics; titles, labels and dashboards don't count; 0 if there are none
caption_font: Font family of the burned-in captions
motion: Main picture motion. One of: none, slow_zoom, pan, layer_animation, generated_video
visuals: How the pictures were made. One of: ai_image, stock, hand_drawn_or_design_tool, vector_generated_by_code, ai_video, live_action, game_or_simulation_render
background: Main background colour as a #rrggbb hex value
character_reused: true or false: is one original character reused across scenes
scene_pattern: true or false: does each scene open on the character alone, then show the props
music: true or false: is there a music bed
voice: The narrator added for this video, not speech inside clips or songs. One of: human, tts, none
automation: How it was assembled. One of: manual_editor, template_app, code
